Date: December 1, 2025

=======================================================================
EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
=======================================================================

Costco Wholesale Corporation continues to demonstrate the qualities that have
made it a cornerstone holding in consumer staples portfolios: resilient membership
model, consistent compounding, and pricing power. However, the stock's current
valuation demands careful consideration of near-term headwinds, including the
ongoing tariff litigation.

=======================================================================
CURRENT VALUATION METRICS
=======================================================================

Current Trading Price:      $912.91
EPS (TTM):                  $18.70
P/E Ratio (TTM):            45.86x
Dividend Yield:             0.61%
Market Capitalization:      $381.0 billion
52-Week Range:              $844.06 - $1,078.23
Forward 1-Year Target:      $1,034.50 (consensus)
Beta (5Y):                  0.98

=======================================================================
ANALYST CONSENSUS
=======================================================================

Overall Rating: BUY (based on 30 analyst opinions)

Rating Breakdown:
  Strong Buy:    3  (10%)
  Buy:          18  (60%)
  Hold:         13  (43%)
  Sell:          2   (7%)
  Strong Sell:   0   (0%)

Net Bullish: 21 analysts (70%)
Net Bearish: 2 analysts (7%)

Note: Some analysts overlap across categories in the consensus.

=======================================================================
RECENT ANALYST ACTIONS
=======================================================================

2025-11-25  RBC Capital            Buy              $1,021.22
2025-11-11  UBS                    Overweight       $1,141.66
2025-10-20  Cowen                  Overweight       $1,055.22
2025-09-30  Piper Sandler          Overweight       $747.17
2025-09-18  Credit Suisse          Hold             $1,247.81
2025-09-17  Cowen                  Outperform       $869.64
2025-09-01  Wedbush                Overweight       $1,141.84
2025-07-07  Morgan Stanley         Overweight       $1,035.72
2025-06-30  JP Morgan              Buy              $801.65

Price Target Range: $747.17 - $1,247.81
Average Price Target: ~$1,035

=======================================================================
RECENT DEVELOPMENTS
=======================================================================

1. Tariff Litigation (Dec 1, 2025):
   Costco has filed a lawsuit against the Trump administration to secure
   eligibility for tariff refunds if the U.S. Supreme Court strikes down
   the president's global tariffs policy. This proactive legal strategy
   reflects management's confidence and commitment to shareholder value
   protection. The case outcome could materially impact near-term cost
   structure but represents manageable risk given Costco's pricing power
   and membership fee revenue.

2. Holiday Season Outlook:
   Industry coverage positions COST among strong Q4 performers, citing
   loyal customer base, diverse retail channels, and resilient traffic
   trends. Black Friday inventory levels were reported as "very well
   replenished," suggesting management's supply chain execution remains
   strong.

=======================================================================
INDEPENDENT ASSESSMENT
=======================================================================

BULL CASE:
• The membership model generates sticky, recurring revenue with high
  renewal rates (>90% internationally).
• Pricing power allows Costco to pass through select cost increases
  without member attrition.
• International expansion (particularly China) offers significant long-
  term growth runway.
• Analyst consensus target of $1,034.50 implies ~13.4% upside from
  current levels.
• Low beta (0.98) provides defensive characteristics in volatile
  markets.

BEAR CASE:
• Current valuation at 45.9x TTM EPS is expensive relative to broader
  consumer staples peers and historical averages.
• Tariff litigation introduces regulatory uncertainty and potential
  cost overruns in the near term.
• Dividend yield of 0.61% is modest; income-oriented investors may
  seek higher-yielding alternatives.
• Stock has declined ~15% from 52-week high ($1,078.23), suggesting
  some momentum headwinds.

NEUTRAL FACTORS:
• The membership model creates an inherent conflict of interest where
  Costco benefits from member retention but faces pressure to maintain
  low prices. This dynamic has historically been well-managed.
• E-commerce penetration remains lower than traditional retailers,
  representing both a risk (competition from Amazon) and opportunity
  (room for improvement).

=======================================================================
INVESTMENT RECOMMENDATION
=======================================================================

ATLAS INVESTMENT ADVISORS VIEW: ACCUMULATE

At $912.91, Costco's valuation is rich but not irrational given the
quality of its business model and the defensibility of its competitive
position. The current level represents a more attractive entry point
than earlier in 2025, particularly given:

1. The tariff litigation is likely a manageable, one-time risk that
   will be resolved within 12-18 months.
2. Analyst consensus supports further appreciation to the $1,035
   average target.
3. The membership model provides visibility and durability that few
   consumer staples peers can match.

We recommend building positions on weakness, with a medium-term price
target of $1,035 (analyst consensus) representing approximately 13%
upside. Full position recommendation would require confirmation from
next quarter's membership growth and same-store sales data.

=======================================================================
KEY RISKS TO MONITOR
=======================================================================
• Tariff litigation outcome and potential cost impacts
• U.S. consumer spending trends in discretionary categories
• International expansion execution (China market)
• Membership renewal rates
• Competition from Amazon, Walmart, and other warehouse clubs
• Interest rate sensitivity (membership fee prepayments)

=======================================================================
DISCLAIMER
=======================================================================

This report is prepared by the Consumer Staples research team at Atlas
Investment Advisors for internal and client distribution. All data is
sourced from public analyst reports, company filings, and market data
providers. Past performance is not indicative of future results. This
report does not constitute a recommendation to buy or sell any security.

=======================================================================
PREPARED BY:
Consumer Staples Research Team
Atlas Investment Advisors
